scripts.dev: bun run link && bun run prepare:docs && bunx --bun nuxt dev
scripts.build: bun run link && bun run prepare:docs && bunx --bun nuxt build
scripts.generate: bun run link && bun run prepare:docs && bunx --bun nuxt generate
scripts.typecheck: bun run link && bun run prepare:docs && bunx --bun nuxt prepare && vue-tsc --noEmit -p .nuxt/tsconfig.app.json
scripts.postinstall: bun run link && bunx --bun nuxt prepare
